game.title: The Callisto Protocol
game.blurb: Sci-fi survival horror set on Jupiter's moon Callisto in 2320, from Striking Distance Studios, released 2022-12-01. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Riot Mode

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "The Callisto Protocol" or "Callisto Protocol". callistoprotocol.fandom.com answers the API, with about 21 linked articles, mostly cast, crew and patches, plus "Black Iron Prison" and "Hardcore Mode"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 1544020 is "The Callisto Protocol™"; its schema has a blank game name. 23 of 46 Steam achievements are hidden and have no descriptions; they sit in the story chapter. RAWG lists "The Callisto Protocol: Final Transmission" (2023-06-29) as its own entry. "Finish Final Transmission" is followed in the Steam list by six achievements (Protocol Data Drives, Security Lock, Escape Pod, Biobot, Kinetic Hammer and Hammer Crates on the Factory Floor) with low unlock rates (2.3 to 11.8%); they were put in the Final Transmission chapter from their position, which needs checking, especially the data drives and the security lock. "Big Spender" (spend 20,000 Credits) could belong to Riot Mode, which also uses Credits; it sits with weapons.
